newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Portuguese PM looking to boost Argentine ties.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese PM looking to boost Argentine ties.

text.p: Portugal is trying to boost its underdeveloped links with South American countries like Argentina, Portuguese Prime Minister Antonio Guterres said Tuesday.
"Unhappily the economic relations between Argentina and Portugal are almost zero," Guterres told reporters at a news conference in Buenos Aires.

He said he had discussed how to bolster commercial ties between the two countries with Argentine President Carlos Menem. Portugal is striving to increase links with all members of the Mercosur customs union, which groups Argentina with Paraguay, Uruguay, and Portuguese-speaking Brazil.
Guterres was speaking at the close of a two-day visit to Argentina.
